jobs.title: Director, Application Architecture & Integration
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

TEEMA Group is partnering with a well-established, growing Vancouver accounting firm to find a hands-on, builder-minded Director, Application Architecture & Integration
. The firm runs on Microsoft and Azure
. This leader will own application and integration architecture, including the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform, connect the specialized accounting, audit and tax applications the firm’s professionals rely on, and modernize how software is built through AI-assisted engineering and DevOps.

At this firm’s size, you’ll set the direction and roll up your sleeves, with real influence and visibility across the firm.

Salary:
$159,000–$215,000 per year - & Discretionary bonus

Work arrangement:

On-site during the first few weeks of onboarding, then hybrid with 3 days in the Vancouver office and 2 days remote
.

What You’ll Do

Application Architecture & Engineering
Lead application architecture and design on Microsoft and Azure, staying hands-on in design, prototyping and code review.
Build modern engineering practices: source control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub).
Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development (such as GitHub Copilot and Azure OpenAI) to significantly improve delivery speed and quality.
Build security into the development lifecycle.

Integration Architecture
Own integration architecture and API standards on Azure Integration Services (API Management, Service Bus, Functions, Logic Apps).
Integrate industry-specific accounting, audit, tax and practice management applications with Dynamics 365 and the firm’s core platforms through APIs.
Make sure integrations are secure, resilient and monitored.

Microsoft Dynamics 365
Provide technical leadership for the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environment, including architecture, customization standards and integration design.
Work with implementation partners, and build internal capability to support and extend the platform.

Team & Data
Build and lead a small team covering development, integration and QA, and balance internal staff with partners.
Over time, set direction for data architecture, reporting and analytics.

What You Bring

A strong background in application architecture and software engineering, ideally progressing from developer to architect to leader.
Hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience
(architecture, customization, integration) and Power Platform.
Hands-on experience with Azure integration and APIs
, including connecting third-party and vendor applications, plus the Microsoft stack
(.NET, Azure DevOps or GitHub, Entra ID).
Experience building DevOps and engineering practices, and using AI-assisted development
to boost productivity.
1–2+ years in a Director or Head of role
, or equivalent senior architecture leadership.
Clear communication with both technical teams and firm leadership.
Nice to have:
Experience in accounting, professional services, legal or financial services
Data engineering or analytics experience

You’ll Thrive Here If You

Are a builder who enjoys creating capabilities from scratch, likes being close to the work in a mid-sized firm, sets high standards without bureaucracy, and is excited by how AI can change the way technology is delivered.
